home_meta_title: Utsuwa: Open-Source AI Companion with 3D VRM Avatars
home_meta_description: Open-source AI companion with 3D VRM avatars, voice chat, semantic memory, and support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local LLMs. Desktop app and web. Self-hosted, privacy-first.
home_meta_description_short: Open-source AI companion with 3D VRM avatars, voice chat, semantic memory, and support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local LLMs.

hero_lede: Utsuwa is a free, open-source AI companion with a 3D VRM avatar, voice chat, and memory that lasts. Bring your own keys or run it fully offline.
letter_title: We built the body. You decide what fills it.
letter_body: Most AI lives in a text box and forgets you by morning. Utsuwa gives yours a face, a voice, and a memory, on your own keys or fully offline, with nothing routed through us.
mark_note: 器, utsuwa: a vessel. Traditionally read as four containers with a dog keeping watch.
sc_presence_title: Not a chat window. Someone in the room.
sc_presence_sub: Load any VRM avatar and she breathes, looks around, and answers out loud with lip-synced voice. Replies float up as speech bubbles that follow her as she moves.
sc_presence_alt: Tsuki, a 3D VRM companion, sitting on a wooden stool
sc_msg_1: you've been quiet today. rough meeting?
sc_msg_3: you only say "it's fine" three times when it isn't
sc_msg_4: want to vent, or should i distract you with that ramen place you saved?
sc_memory_sub: Your people, your plans, the little things you only mention once. Local embeddings weave every chat into memories she recalls by meaning, and your bond grows across eight stages, from Stranger to Soulmate.

features_title: Made to play with, not just talk to
feature_custom_body: Drop in any VRM from VRoid Hub or Booth, or start with Tsuki, Yuki, or Momo.
feature_custom_alt: Momo, Tsuki, and Yuki, three 3D VRM companions, posing together around a stool
feature_ar_body: Stand her on your real floor through the camera in Android Chrome or any WebXR headset, and keep chatting the whole time.
feature_ar_alt: A phone showing a VRM companion standing in a real hallway through the camera
feature_photo_body: Pick a pose, frame the shot, drop in stickers, and save it. Your camera roll is about to get cuter.
